title: Four Chinese regulators issue rules on algorithmic recommendation services, effective 1 March 2022
summary: The provisions, announced by the Cyberspace Administration of China with three other bodies, set obligations on content oversight, user choice and filing for providers.

title: TSMC says it plans 2022 capital spending of USD 40-44 billion
summary: The chipmaker raised its capital budget at its fourth-quarter 2021 results, as reported by Design & Reuse.

title: Intel announces a USD 20 billion chip-fabrication site near Columbus, Ohio
summary: The plan foresees more than 3,000 permanent jobs, construction starting in late 2022 and operations targeted for 2025, with possible CHIPS Act co-funding.

title: Meta announces its AI Research SuperCluster, which it says will be among the fastest AI supercomputers
summary: Trade coverage reports a planned 16,000 GPUs and 5 exaflops of compute for Meta's research.

title: OpenAI publishes InstructGPT, language models fine-tuned with human feedback to follow instructions
summary: OpenAI's publication 'Aligning language models to follow instructions' describes models trained with human feedback to be more helpful and less toxic.

title: China's Cyberspace Administration publishes draft rules restricting deepfakes, with fines up to 100,000 yuan, ForkLog reports
summary: The draft would require identity checks, consent for edits to faces and voices and labelling of altered files, with public comment open until 28 February 2022.
